summary: Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (TGS), an Argentine natural gas transmission issuer listed on NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that Alternate Director Flavia Vanesa Bevilacqua resigned effective October 6, 2026, citing personal reasons, per a letter dated the same day. The resignation, tied to a director originally appointed at the April 15, 2026 annual shareholders meeting, will be considered by the board at its next meeting. No financial terms, advisor, premium, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure of a non-executive board departure, not a special situation; no deal or arbitrage angle arises.
